description: This file is a Perl test script that verifies the behavior of the internal utility function '_collapse_dotdot' in the Git::SVN::Utils module. It tests the function with various path examples to ensure correct collapsing of directory paths involving '..' and '.' components.

methods.name: _collapse_dotdot
methods.description: A utility function from the Git::SVN::Utils module that collapses directory paths by resolving '.' and '..' segments.
